typography.rules: Inverted text on reverse face of table tent-cards (`rotation: 180;`) with doubled margins

geometry.symmetry: Mirrored reversal across central folding axis

steps.step: 1. Faltachse in der exakten Mitte des Bogens festlegen.
2. Obere Hälfte für Tischaufsteller mit `rotation: 180;` invertieren.
3. Double head margins on inverted page (TOAD Rule 12: axis inversion).
4. Indicate dashed score line for printer finishing orientation.

no_gos.no_go: Never design tent-cards without inverting second panel (otherwise prints upside down)
